_doc: Momo Letters: improvement proposals an assigned Momo writes to the mailbox at real milestones. Each letter is written once. `industry` is a building type; the sender is a Momo assigned to a building of that type (the one who has done the most work there; ties to the lowest id). `trigger`: {work: {type: n}} = Momo (not the player) have finished n work stages at buildings of that type; {mastery: {type: level}} = that building mastery reached level. At most `balance.mail.letters_per_day` letters arrive on one day, so milestones met together come on following days. `research` is the improvement it proposes -- real agronomy and engineering, never magic. Text lives in data/i18n/ui.csv under the title/body keys.
